required_packet.purpose: Required public-safe evidence packet for replay-derived policy or fixture changes.

gates.setup: Copy into .github/workflows/ and add the check to branch protection.
gates.enforcement: Add cavra-aispm-review-packet as a required status check before merge.

gates.setup: Include in merge-request pipelines and require the governance job before merge.
gates.enforcement: Require the cavra-aispm-review-packet job in merge-request approval rules.

gates.setup: Create a Build validation policy with this pipeline as a required gate.
gates.enforcement: Configure branch policy Build validation with cavra-aispm-review-packet required.

readiness_checklist: Copy the platform template into the repository CI configuration.
Require the cavra-aispm-review-packet check before merge.
Attach or commit cavra-replay-policy-review-packet.json with replay-derived policy and fixture changes.
Verify the gate fails closed when replay-derived changes do not include a valid packet.
Keep production enforcement behind normal CAVRA policy publishing and approval gates.
